functions.name: acquire
functions.description: Acquire a browser realm session for a game; returns {session_id, mode, backend}. mode (default 'headless') is one of: 'headless' (launch Chrome, no display — fast, for bots at scale); 'rendered' (launch headful + VNC — watchable live); 'attached' (do NOT launch — drive an EXISTING real Chrome over CDP, e.g. the desktop browser; borrowed, so release never closes it, and only one attached session may be active at a time). mode is fixed for the session's life.

functions.name: release
functions.description: Release a session: tear its Chrome down and drop the row.

functions.name: reset
functions.description: Reset a session in place: close every tab, keep the browser + slot, open one fresh blank tab.

functions.name: status
functions.description: Status of one session (pass session_id) or all (omit it). Returns {sessions: [{session_id, game, mode, backend, egress, tabs, ...}]}; egress is the inert VPN seam.

functions.name: tab_open
functions.description: Open a new tab (optionally at url). Returns {tab_id}.

functions.name: tab_list
functions.description: List the session's live tabs. Returns {tabs: [...]}.

functions.name: tab_activate
functions.description: Bring a tab to the foreground by tab_id.

functions.name: observe
functions.description: Read a tab's RENDERED page (post-JS DOM). Returns {tab_id, html, url, title}. Omit tab_id for the active page.

functions.name: screenshot
functions.description: Capture a PNG of a tab. Returns {tab_id, image (base64), format}. full_page=true captures beyond the viewport.

functions.name: cdp
functions.description: Relay an arbitrary Chrome DevTools Protocol method to the engine and return {result}. This single verb IS the full act surface (e.g. method='Page.navigate' params={url}; method='Runtime.evaluate' params={expression,returnByValue}). Routed to the tab when tab_id is given, else a default page; pass tab_id='__browser__' for browser-level methods. Discover available methods via the 'commands' verb.

functions.name: commands
functions.description: Return the running Chrome's LIVE CDP protocol descriptor (/json/protocol): every domain/method/param available through the 'cdp' relay. Pass session_id to read that session's engine, or omit it for a throwaway probe browser. This is the dynamic, discoverable command catalog — not a hardcoded copy.

emitters.description: Fires on a realm-side browser event. Payload {session_id, tab_id, kind, data} where kind is e.g. 'page_loaded', 'dialog', or 'crashed' — projected as rlm.browser.<kind>. Effectors subscribe filtered to their session_id. Best-effort live signalling, not durable delivery.
